messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected in control-plane services (auth, org-lookup). Trigger: 5min rolling > 5% 5xx. Paging ben_oncall.

ben_oncall: on it. confirming metrics + checking traces. any known deploys in the last 30m?

alice_ops: i see a spike in gateway 502/504s and timeouts to controlplane-config and org-lookup around 14:19 UTC. latency p95 for auth jumped from 80ms -> 1.2s.

carmen_sre: no infra deploys in last hour from release pipeline. there was a config push to controlplane-config 2h ago. i'll pull logs now.

david_support: getting reports from a handful of customers about failed API calls (500). one ticket shows: "error: downstream org lookup timeout". bringing customer-impact details to thread.

ben_oncall: pulling logs from gateways and controlplane-auth:
```
# sample from auth-proxy logs
2026-03-15T14:18:57Z error auth/lookup timeout duration=1205ms svc=org-lookup host=org-db-1
2026-03-15T14:19:01Z warn gateway upstream 502 service=controlplane-config
2026-03-15T14:19:12Z error request_id=abcd1234 status=500 reason="org_lookup_failure"
```

infra-bot: autoscaler: attempted scale 2->4 controlplane-config pods in us-east-1, provisioning delayed by cloud capacity error (insufficient vCPU) at 14:20:45Z.

alice_ops: interesting — autoscaling tried to add nodes but failed. that would amplify 5xx if queue backs up. can we temporarily increase retry windows or enable fallback path for org lookup?

carmen_sre: suggestion: enable legacy-org-lookup fallback (reads cached org mapping) and open circuit for non-mandatory calls. fallback config path: `controlplane.config.orglookup.fallback=true`. I can flip it if we agree.

ben_oncall: agree. prepping change. posting runbook steps:
```
# flip fallback and reduce retries
rbxctl config set controlplane.config.orglookup.fallback true --env prod
rbxctl deploy controlplane-config --restart
# lower client retries to avoid upstream pressure
rbxctl config set gateway.retries.max 1 --env prod
```

carmen_sre: i'm applying the flag now. will restart pods gracefully (rolling restart).

carmen_sre: applied flag + started rolling restart. 3/6 pods restarted, healthchecks passing.

ben_oncall: monitoring metrics... 5xx rate trending down from 6.8% -> 2.1% over 3 minutes. p95 latency for auth 1.2s -> 320ms.

infra-bot: note: cloud provider still reporting delayed node provisioning in us-east-1; autoscaler backoff in effect.

david_support: customer impact update: 7 customers reported errors in last 30m. SLO hit for 3 enterprise tenants. i'm preparing interim customer comms.

eve_pm: i'll draft a status page update: short summary + mitigation + ETA for full recovery. keep me posted if rollback needed.

ben_oncall: moving to mitigated state. ops actions done: fallback flag enabled, rolling restart of controlplane-config, gateway retries reduced. Next steps: continue monitoring, coordinate with infra for node provisioning, and run longer tail tests. handing on-call to carmen_sre for next 2h.

carmen_sre: ack takeover. summary for next shift:
- Root cause: controlplane-config queue/backpressure due to cloud node provisioning delay -> upstream timeouts (org lookup/auth) -> gateway 5xx.
- Immediate mitigation: enabled cached fallback and reduced retries; rolling restart of controlplane-config pods.
- Impact: transient 5xx spike, ~7 customers affected, SLO risk for 3 tenants.
- Long term actions: work with cloud team to investigate provisioning failures, add capacity fallback region routing, and add circuit breakers to org-lookup caller.

ben_oncall: leaving detailed notes in incident tracker (#INC-2026-123). handoff complete. :white_check_mark:

david_support: copying handoff notes to customer tickets and tagging CSMs.

eve_pm: status page draft ready, will publish once we confirm stability for 15m.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. recorded timeline and runbook run. incident channel will remain open for postmortem input.

carmen_sre: start of postmortem checklist: collect traces, full logs for 14:00-14:45 UTC, autoscaler events, and config history. assigning owners: infra (node provisioning) and runtime (circuit breakers).

ben_oncall: thanks team. I'll be reachable if anything regresses.

carmen_sre: thanks, closing active pager. continuing monitoring.
